# netdata_notification_room_settings (Resource)

Provides a Netdata Cloud room notification settings resource. The values set here override the space-wide values from `netdata_notification_space_settings` for a single room.
Destroying this resource removes the override, and the room falls back to the space-wide value.
Available only in paid plans.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netdata_notification_room_settings" "test" {
  space_id           = "<space_id>"
  room_id            = "<room_id>"
  reachability_delay = 180
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reachability_delay` (Number) Node reachability notification delay in seconds for this room. Overrides the space-wide value set by `netdata_notification_space_settings`. Must be at least 30 seconds.
- `room_id` (String) The ID of the room the override applies to.
- `space_id` (String) The ID of the space.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the notification settings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh

terraform import netdata_notification_room_settings.test space_id,room_id
```
